responses.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_total_to_product_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The ratio is computed per line item (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost) and then averaged, rather than dividing the sums. Line items with a zero derived_product_cost would cause division errors or NULLs, and none are filtered out.
Only invoices that have at least one line item are considered, since line items are counted from Invoice_Line_Items.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, because the request gives no tie-breaker.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of summed costs per invoice (SUM(total)/SUM(product cost)) instead of the average of per-line ratios.

assumptions.assumption: Average ratio is the mean of per-line-item ratios (total_cost / product_cost), not the ratio of summed totals; line items with NULL or zero product cost are not specially handled (NULL ratios are ignored by AVG, zero may error or yield NULL depending on the DBMS).
Line items are counted from Invoice_Line_Items, so only invoices with at least one line item appear. Ties at the 10th position are broken by invoice_number ascending.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of summed totals to summed product costs per invoice, rather than the mean of per-line ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / SUM(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Average ratio is the mean of per-line-item ratios (derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost), not the ratio of sums. Line items with NULL or zero derived_product_cost are skipped by the average in most engines (NULL) or may cause errors/NULL if zero, while still counted in line_item_count.
Line items are counted as rows in Invoice_Line_Items; invoices with no line items are excluded. Ties at the 10th position are broken by invoice_number ascending.

alternatives.interpretation: Ratio of summed costs per invoice (total of derived_total_cost divided by total of derived_product_cost) rather than the mean of per-line ratios.
